short_scenes.name: Volt
short_scenes.narration: Volt switched on the geyser while the AC was running, and the MCB tripped. Why?
Your home is wired in parallel. Every appliance gets the full voltage, but every new path adds more current. Watch the total climb.

short_scenes.name: Volt
short_scenes.narration: In parallel, each appliance gets its own path from the supply. Every path you add lets more current flow from the main line, just like opening more taps on one water pipe.

short_scenes.name: Volt
short_scenes.narration: Too much total current heats the wires, so the MCB cuts the power to protect you.

short_scenes.name: Volt
short_scenes.say: Watch the full video: Parallel circuits!
